references.text: The context for this inheritance law; the daughters of Zelophehad came to Moses and asked for an inheritance since their father died without sons
Further provisions about inheritance through daughters, stating that daughters who inherit must marry within their own tribe to preserve the inheritance
The fulfillment of this law when the daughters of Zelophehad received their inheritance in the land of Canaan as the Lord had commanded Moses
The complete inheritance law that follows, with provisions for cases where there are no daughters either
Zelophehad is mentioned as a man without sons, only daughters, which led to this legislation
Another example of inheritance through a daughter when there are no sons, in the genealogy of Sheshan
